title: Webb County Constable Precinct 1 Shares Thanksgiving Greeting
excerpt: Webb County shared a Thanksgiving greeting from Constable Precinct 1 Guadalupe Gomez on Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026, wishing Webb County families a happy holiday.
content:
Webb County shared a Thanksgiving greeting from Constable Precinct 1 Guadalupe Gomez on Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026.

The greeting, shared on the county's Facebook page, wished Webb County families a happy Thanksgiving.
